notes.title: New hunter added
notes.content: [p]The game currently features the following hunters: swordsman, archer, sorceress, warrior, druid, and the recently added spearman.[/p][p]Since the warrior, druid, and spearmen were the latest additions, let's talk about them.[/p][p]The warrior would be a hunter with a savage boxing style and moleman shapeshifting abilities. All of their gameplay is converted to boxing skills, as well as the moleman transformation, which enhances their physical abilities.[/p][p]The druid uses fortification skills and plant skills to fight. You choose your combat style between physical and magical damage.[/p][p]The spearman, like the druid, has two combat styles: physical with the spear and magical using their wooden arm. The spear style has high physical damage and movement, while the magical style deals area and medium-range damage.[/p][p]Now begins the development of the last hunter of this first phase; he will be something like a mage.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45479430/ed5ac7e28252449d0889d6846e85e0408cab562b.png"][/img][/p]
